scope: diagnostic pre-video only; not shipping final gate

observations: Seal balancing a beach ball; animal eye retained. Thin double contour/white rim follows the colored original.

Four-connected map components each have one label; visual enclosure coverage assessed separately.

defects.description: Beach-ball top wedge label 4 at (405,73) lies at a seam junction and is crossed/crowded by the ball contours at phone size (3.75px radius).
